rules.native_mapping: Write the user job, subject, hierarchy, signature interaction, and critique gate before selecting native primitives.
rules.validation_rule: A screen brief names hierarchy, primary action, and one subject-specific decision.
rules.legal_treatment: adapted independently from Apache-2.0 concepts; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Reject hero, hover, page, and browser-output directives; use screens, touch, gestures, sheets, and system navigation.

rules.native_mapping: Query a compact mobile intelligence catalog, then validate recommendations against the selected framework and platform guidance.
rules.validation_rule: Every recommendation identifies a native primitive, a token family, and an applicable platform.
rules.legal_treatment: independently authored catalog informed by MIT-licensed source structure; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not emit utility classes, stylesheet output, browser breakpoints, or web component code.

rules.native_mapping: Set deliberate density, contrast, shape, typography, and motion dials for a touch-first screen.
rules.validation_rule: The critique records selected dials and rejects at least one generic or mismatched visual choice.
rules.legal_treatment: adapted independently from MIT-licensed concepts; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Reject DOM, stylesheet, landing-page, and web-vitals instructions.

rules.native_mapping: Use compatible React Native registry metadata only to discover a component shape; compose it from local native primitives and tokens.
rules.validation_rule: The chosen component has native semantics, states, and no mandatory external service.
rules.legal_treatment: independently authored routing from MIT-licensed source capabilities; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Never use a registry as a Flutter, SwiftUI, or Compose dependency and never import web component output.

rules.native_mapping: Run a local brief-to-constraints-to-component plan with interaction, async, semantic, and adaptive states.
rules.validation_rule: The emitted plan is reproducible locally and names target-framework primitives.
rules.legal_treatment: concept-only; no copied prose or code because the source license is incomplete
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not call or require a remote component API, DOM output, or browser runtime.

rules.native_mapping: Keep state local, derive values instead of duplicating state, stabilize list identity, and measure before memoizing.
rules.validation_rule: A render or list change has a focused test or measured rationale and preserves interaction behavior.
rules.legal_treatment: independently summarized from MIT-declared skill guidance; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Reject SSR, server components, browser caches, Next.js, DOM APIs, and web bundle guidance.

rules.native_mapping: Translate named phases, easing, duration, and stagger to AnimationController, Animated, SwiftUI Animation, or Compose transition primitives.
rules.validation_rule: The recipe has an interruptible resting state and a reduced-motion equivalent.
rules.legal_treatment: independently authored translation of MIT-licensed concepts; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Never install the source animation runtime or emit timeline code for a browser.

rules.native_mapping: Map variant states, springs, entry and exit, gestures, and shared continuity to native platform animation APIs.
rules.validation_rule: Every transition defines state names, cancellation behavior, and a no-distance reduced-motion fallback.
rules.legal_treatment: independently authored translation of MIT-licensed concepts; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Never install the source runtime or generate browser animation APIs.

rules.native_mapping: Keep backend access at the application boundary and pass typed loading, empty, error, retry, and populated UI states into presentation components.
rules.validation_rule: A component can render all async states without importing backend internals.
rules.legal_treatment: concept-only; no copied prose or code because the repository has no license
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not add a backend SDK, server action, or web data framework unless the app already owns that integration.

rules.native_mapping: Audit list virtualization, images, navigation, gestures, accessibility, insets, text scaling, and animation using React Native APIs; apply Expo rules only when Expo is detected.
rules.validation_rule: The audit records framework detection and avoids Expo-only APIs in a bare project.
rules.legal_treatment: independently summarized from MIT-declared skill guidance; notice retained
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Reject browser, DOM, SSR, and web performance rules.

rules.native_mapping: Use app-appropriate Material or Cupertino widgets, ThemeExtension, LayoutBuilder, TextScaler, Semantics, SafeArea, and native animation APIs.
rules.validation_rule: Widget tests cover semantic state, largest text scale, RTL, compact and tablet constraints, and touch targets.
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not add web plugins, CSS, or any browser runtime to a mobile-only target.

rules.native_mapping: Use semantic text styles, environment values, dynamic type, size classes, NavigationStack, sheets, accessibility traits, and SwiftUI animations.
rules.validation_rule: XCTest and simulator coverage validate size classes, accessibility text, RTL, insets, and reduced motion.
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not translate SwiftUI screens to a browser layout or fixed desktop breakpoint model.

rules.native_mapping: Use immutable token types, composition locals, window size classes, Material3, semantics, Insets, font scaling, and Compose animation APIs.
rules.validation_rule: Unit, lint, screenshot, and instrumentation coverage validate adaptive layout, semantics, and reduced motion.
rules.web_runtime_rejection: Do not use web layout, stylesheet, or browser animation APIs.
